name: dynamic-import-namespace
description: A dynamic import's namespace object that escapes, here the import call passed as an argument, references every export of the module it loads. A const binding of the awaited object binds the namespace as an `import * as` does, so each read through it is judged where it is read; one the program reads a property of directly references that export alone, and an import whose result nothing uses references none, so the exports never read are reported.
